main_text.head: VARIA POEMATA.
LIBER III.
CARMINA, A GEORGIO Buchanano olim scripta, nunc primùm typis edita.

p.i: Hortatur adolescentes Burdegalenses ad cultum honestarum artium.
VAsconis tellus, genitrix virorum Fortium, blandi genitrix Lyæi, Cui parens frugum fauet, & relictis Pallas Athenis:
Te licet claris decoret triumphis Martius belli labor, & vetusti Nominis splendor, seriésque longum Ducta per ævum,
Nitandem doctas fouet Camœnas, Et bonas artes opera fideli, Spes tuas vano studio in futuros Porrigis annos.

page.notes: The initial V is a woodcut ornamental letter, read as V. The final word "Non" at the lower right is cut off by the right edge of the scan, so it is printed only in part and the line continues beyond the image. The poem lines are set in italic. The marginal text at the right edge is show-through or the edge of the neighbouring page and is left out.
